verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers supports event-driven automation via Cron Triggers/scheduling, Queues, Workflows (multi-step chains with retries and pause-for-external-event/approval), and Event Subscriptions where Cloudflare products publish structured events to a queue that Workers can consume to trigger custom logic/integrations. This directly matches 'rules that trigger actions automatically on events' for an AI-native builder. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks of rule-trigger reliability/latency at scale, and clearer docs on defining conditional 'rules' (vs just event->consumer wiring) rather than raw event plumbing.
